provenance.collectedAtRule: asOf is the ONLY collection date in this file. A month is read as its first instant, never its last, so a record can never read as fresher than the file can prove. Do not add per-record dates; that would be a second anchor for the same fact.
provenance.sourceRule: A record without a url has no source anyone can reopen. It must render as unknown, never as a check that was performed.
